about: Words that mark text as unfinished. lint-film.mjs (placeholder-copy) and copy-check.py (placeholder, --ui) read this file; src/lib/placeholder.ts carries the same lists for the layout audit (scripts/test/placeholder.test.mjs keeps them equal). words: matched anywhere in a string, on word boundaries, any case. labels: a whole string that is only a generic label. numbered: a generic noun with a number and nothing else (Item 1, Card 3). A real product's own copy never needs any of them.
